# Discovery & Translational Science

**Base editing permanently lowers lipid levels** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00187-2)  
- In vivo base editing achieved durable lipid reduction in preclinical models, supporting a one-time therapeutic strategy for dyslipidemia.

**LRRK2 armadillo domain variants activate kinase via Rab-binding site–dependent mechanism** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.24.26368659)  
- The Parkinson’s-linked Madrid haplotype (L119P/L488P) increases LRRK2-mediated Rab10 phosphorylation ~2-fold in cellular assays and primary immune cells from carriers; L488P drives the effect via the ARM domain’s Rab-binding interface, distinct from ROC-COR or kinase domain variants.

**TNF superfamily proteomics implicate TNF signaling in atherosclerotic stroke** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.29.26352088)  
- In 45,783 UK Biobank participants, 34 TNF-superfamily proteins associated with incident ischemic stroke, MI, and PVD; IPD meta-analysis of 2,051 post-stroke patients linked TNF-α to vascular recurrence; plaque transcriptomics (n=43) confirmed TNF pathway enrichment.

**APOE ε4 → cognitive decline sequentially mediated by plasma p-tau217 → hippocampal atrophy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.22.26368713)  
- In the Singapore Harmonization cohort (N=659, 29.4% ε4+), ε4 associated with higher baseline p-tau217, which mediated faster cognitive decline and dementia risk; hippocampal atrophy mediated the p-tau217→dementia link. Cerebrovascular markers (WMH) were not significant mediators.

**Plasma p-tau217 + WMH + hippocampal volume panel optimizes cognitive decline prediction** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368742)  
- In a Singapore memory-clinic/community cohort (mean follow-up 51 months), the three-marker combination outperformed individual biomarkers for longitudinal CDR-SB progression in a population with high cerebrovascular disease burden.

**[Biotech] CBP/EP300 inhibition overcomes androgen receptor modulator resistance in prostate cancer** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.24.26368506)  
- Regulatory network modeling in >10,000 prostate cancer patients nominated EP300 as top actionable target for APM resistance. The CBP/EP300 inhibitor pocenbrodib suppressed oxidative phosphorylation and fatty acid metabolism in preclinical models and showed clinical benefit in one APM-resistant metastatic patient (NCT04575766).

**Interferon-driven T-cell activation and senescence signature define active localized scleroderma** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368779)  
- Bulk RNA-seq of 60 adult lesions vs. 22 controls: 704 DEGs enriched for interferon signaling, antigen presentation, Th differentiation. Active/inflammatory lesions showed fibroblast, macrophage, and T-cell expansion with co-expression of effector and senescence programs (p16INK4a+); fibrotic lesions were transcriptionally quiescent.

**ARB therapy expands juxtaglomerular renin cells in human IgA nephropathy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.22.26368708)  
- Spatial transcriptomics (154 biopsies, 60 IgAN): ARB-treated patients had 2.66 renin cells/glomerulus vs. 0.99 untreated (adj. diff. 1.30, 95% CI 0.42–2.18). Increase driven by pole JG cells transcribing REN (+19 pp), without smooth muscle cell loss — contrasting murine models.

**Proteinuria and hematuria reflect distinct tissue processes in IgA nephropathy** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.22.26368706)  
- Xenium profiling (3.08M cells, 60 IgAN biopsies): Proteinuria/eGFR correlated with glomerular injury scores and adjacent tubular injury. Hematuria associated with elevated VEGF and phosphoinositide signaling in glomerular endothelium, not injury scores.

**Lower neuromelanin MRI nigral volume marks Lewy body copathology in AD/MCI** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368759)  
- In 73 ADNI participants with autopsy (33 LB+, 40 LB−), SNc volume was lower in LB+ (p<0.05 adjusted). Adding SNc volume to age/sex/executive function improved logistic regression fit for autopsy LB status (ΔAIC).

**Rapamycin mitigates BCAA accumulation and extends survival in MSUD mice** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.10.765222)  
- mTOR inhibition reduced neuroinflammation, muscle pathology, and plasma BCAAs/BCKAs in BCKDH-deficient mice, nominating rapamycin as a candidate therapy for maple syrup urine disease.

**Diffusion models for de novo small-molecule design** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43081981/)  
- Review of generative diffusion frameworks for molecular generation, highlighting conditional design, scaffold hopping, and property optimization benchmarks.

**Automated MEL score replaces visual H-scoring for IHC biomarkers in lung adenocarcinoma** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.10.22.26366204)  
- Fiji/ImageJ pipeline integrates tissue segmentation, tumor-area-weighted quantification, and batch normalization for BRCA1, GLUT1, QKI. MEL correlated with visual H-scores (Spearman ρ) and retained prognostic value in Cox models.

**AORTA-SCAN: automated CTA volumetric biomarkers for type B aortic dissection** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368738)  
- Hierarchical multi-stage segmentation (aorta, true/false lumen) with metal-aware triple-input for post-TEVAR scans. Outputs perfusion dissection index (PDI = perfused FL volume / total perfused aortic volume) for surveillance.

**LLM judges validated for automated oversight of patient-facing communication** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.09.16.26363176)  
- Seven-criterion rubric (safety, accuracy, communication quality) tested on ICON-Bench (800 oncology + 200 non-oncology QA pairs). 19 LLM judges showed high sensitivity for safety violations; general-purpose models outperformed safety-specialized guards.

**Maternal THC exposure upregulates neonatal hypothalamic/reward genes** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368582)  
- Saliva transcriptomics (25 THC-exposed vs. 25 controls): CNR1, POMC upregulated (p<0.05), DRD2 trended (p=0.06). Exposed neonates showed greater early feeding volume and less weight loss; effects modified by sex and co-exposure to opioids.

**LRRK2 Madrid haplotype L488P increases Rab10 phosphorylation in carrier neutrophils/monocytes** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.24.26368659)  
- Multiplexed PRM mass spec confirmed ~2-fold higher pRab10 in primary cells from L488P carriers (with and without PD), validating the cellular phenotype.

**Feedback loops degrade clinical prediction models unless treatment is included as a predictor** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368745)  
- Simulation (CVD risk model parameters): updating models with data from model-guided treatment caused miscalibration (calibration-in-the-large, slope) when treatment was omitted; inclusion of treatment variable resolved bias.

**Generative Latent Protocol Model (GLPM) optimizes sepsis treatment from ICU data** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368780)  
- Probabilistic framework infers latent treatment protocols anchored on admission state; at inference, samples protocols conditioned on target survival. Matched/exceeded eight offline RL baselines on MIMIC-III ICU-Sepsis benchmark.

---

# Early Trials — Phase I–II

**Tapentadol noninferior to pregabalin for preemptive analgesia in total knee arthroplasty** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43080062/)  
- Randomized double-blind noninferiority trial; tapentadol matched pregabalin on pain scores and opioid consumption with favorable GI tolerability.

**Telehealth-supported coordinated spontaneous awakening/breathing trials (TEACH cluster RCT)** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43082011/)  
- Cluster RCT of telehealth-facilitated SAT/SBT protocol in invasively ventilated patients; primary outcome: ventilator-free days.

**NaOCl/EDTA vs. NaOCl/HEDP ± ultrasonic activation for endodontic retreatment pain** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43082053/)  
- RCT (n not specified in abstract) comparing postoperative pain scores; irrigation regimen and ultrasonic activation as factors.

**Sodium oxybate vs. ketamine for anesthesia maintenance in traumatic hemorrhage** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43081834/)  
- Retrospective cohort comparing hemodynamic stability; sodium oxybate associated with less vasopressor requirement.

**Next-generation CGM accuracy and treatment experience in children with diabetes** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43079935/)  
- Clinical trial of a new CGM system; primary endpoints: MARD, sensor survival, patient-reported outcomes.

**Sweat biomarkers enable dynamic blood lactate estimation during exercise** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43080131/)  
- Randomized-order crossover study (normoxia/hypoxia); sweat analyte panel predicted blood lactate with acceptable error.

**AR biofeedback on spatial muscle activity improves knee extensor endurance** [bioRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.11.765967)  
- RCT (n=14): real-time HD-sEMG augmented reality feedback increased repetitions to exhaustion (p<0.001, d=1.41) and shifted spatial activation laterally.

**Thalamic SEEG informs surgical therapy in 117 drug-resistant epilepsy patients** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368733)  
- Consecutive series (2020–2025): thalamic lead hemorrhage 0.3% (all asymptomatic); targeting accuracy ANT 81%, CM 94%, PUL 100%. Early bilateral ictal signals identified bilateral networks (sensitivity 75.6%→92.6% excluding bitemporal). 52 patients proceeded to thalamic/thalamocortical neuromodulation.

**Alleged DMSB bypass for futility analysis** [X / BertrandBio](https://x.com/BertrandBio/status/2125638282977632536)  
- Unconfirmed report of a sponsor conducting an ad hoc futility analysis outside the pre-specified DMSB process; not documented in July AdCom materials. Treat as rumor pending verification.

---

# Late & Pivotal Trials — Phase III

**[Big Pharma] STEP Young: semaglutide phase 3 shows significant weight loss in pediatric obesity** [Nature Medicine](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41591-026-00059-7)  
- Children with obesity on semaglutide lost significantly more weight vs. placebo; >⅓ achieved BMI below obesity threshold. Full publication pending.

**First-in-class RIPTAC enters phase III** [Nature Reviews Drug Discovery](https://www.nature.com/articles/d41573-026-00188-1)  
- RIPTAC (receptor-targeted protein degradation) candidate advances to registrational trial; mechanism and indication not disclosed in brief.

**CONCERN-EWS: AI early warning system associated with 36% mortality reduction in pragmatic cluster-RCT** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368768)  
- Adjusted HR 0.64 (95% CI 0.53–0.78) for in-hospital mortality. Commentary raises three concerns: (1) ICU bed spillover disadvantaging control units, (2) differential exclusion of high-risk patients from intervention arm, (3) large pre-trial mortality imbalances across clusters suggesting inadequate randomization.

**JiVitA-3: geospatial analysis of micronutrient supplementation effects on birth weight and infant wasting** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43080010/)  
- Secondary analysis of cluster RCT in rural Bangladesh; spatial heterogeneity in treatment effects on low birth weight and wasting identified.

**Remote monitoring of cardiac implantable electronic devices: systematic review & component network meta-analysis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43080205/)  
- Synthesis of RCTs comparing remote vs. in-person follow-up; component NMA assessed individual monitoring features (alert types, transmission frequency).

**Mifepristone vs. other interventions for emergency contraception: meta-analysis** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43081835/)  
- Comparative efficacy and safety across regimens; mifepristone favorable on pregnancy prevention with manageable bleeding profile.

---

# Regulatory & Approvals

**FDA approves Welgemda (ribitol) for limb-girdle muscular dystrophy type 2I/R9 — first LGMD treatment** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/news-events/press-announcements/fda-approves-first-treatment-limb-girdle-muscular-dystrophy-type-2ir9)  
- Approved for adults and pediatric patients ≥30 kg with FKRP mutations. Historic milestone: first approved therapy for any limb-girdle muscular dystrophy.

**Medicare sets 2028 prices for 13 drugs under Inflation Reduction Act** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/inflation-reduction-act-2028-final-medicare-drug-price/875717/)  
- Drugs near or past patent expiration face steep price cuts as IRA expands price negotiation scope.

**Notable recent FDA approvals (Sep–Nov 2026)** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/news-events-human-drugs/notable-approvals-drugs)  
- **Bacfenssi** (doxycycline hyclate) — first locally applied agent to reduce surgical site infections after colorectal surgery.  
- **Gazyva** (obinutuzumab) — first drug for primary membranous nephropathy.  
- **Awiqli** (insulin icodec) — first once-weekly insulin for pediatric T2D.  
- **Hovilpri** (pritelivir) — for HSV lesions.  
- **Camzyos** (mavacamten) — pediatric heart condition (rare).  
- **Atebrioz** (zilurgisertib) — third therapy for fibrodysplasia ossificans progressiva.  
- **Onswik** (insulin efsitora alfa) — once-weekly basal insulin for T2D.

**[Biotech] Green Lumber “Natural Fuel For Men” recalled for undeclared tadalafil** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/green-lumber-holdings-llc-issues-recall-and-consumer-safety-alert)  
- Lot GL01 (exp. 09/27) recalled to consumer level; FDA lab confirmed undeclared PDE5 inhibitor.

**Golden State Medical ibuprofen 800 mg tablets recalled for aluminum particulate** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/golden-state-medical-supply-inc-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-ibuprofen-800mg-tablets-due)  
- Lot GS069303 (NDC 51407-841-05), consumer-level recall; contamination localized on tablet surface.

**[Biotech] Par Health recalls 46 lots of six injectable products for particulate matter** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/safety/recalls-market-withdrawals-safety-alerts/par-health-issues-voluntary-nationwide-recall-certain-lots-six-injectable-drug-products-due-presence)  
- Particulates identified as cellulose, polystyrene, stopper material, aluminum; hospital/user-level recall.

**[Biotech] Alkem Laboratories (Daman, India) issued FDA warning letter for significant CGMP violations** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/inspections-compliance-enforcement-and-criminal-investigations/warning-letters/alkem-laboratories-limited-736113-11182026)  
- Inspection reference 320-27-25; cited violations require prompt corrective action to prevent recurrence.

**Domperidone expanded access: current supplier exiting; no distribution after Sept 2025** [FDA](http://www.fda.gov/drugs/investigational-new-drug-application-ind/how-request-domperidone-expanded-access-use)  
- Patients encouraged to identify new supplier for continued access via new expanded access IND.

---

# Business & Strategy

**[Biotech] BioNTech founders in talks to raise ~$1B for new oncology startup** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/pharmalot/2026/11/25/biontech-founders-oncology-startup-gsk-egpa-drug-exdensur/?utm_campaign=rss)  
- Uğur Şahin and Özlem Türeci exploring $1B financing for a new cancer-focused venture; details sparse.

**[Big Pharma] Amgen advances biosimilar Opdivo; Bristol Myers Squibb appoints new CFO; Cogent Biosciences secures cancer approval; Arcus Biosciences and Belite Bio report setbacks** [BioPharma Dive](https://www.biopharmadive.com/news/arcus-quemliclustat-belite-amgen-opdivo-biosimilar/875512/)  
- Amgen’s bevacizumab/Opdivo biosimilar progress; BMS finance leadership change (second this month); Cogent’s FDA win; Arcus (quemliclustat) and Belite (pipeline) disclosed clinical/regulatory hurdles.

**US–China biotechnology decoupling characterized as “not one race but several”** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/25/us-china-biotech-race-policy-data/?utm_campaign=rss)  
- Policy analysis (Michael S. Kinch) argues for targeted engagement over blanket restrictions; data show divergent competitive dynamics across subsectors.

**Trump-era foreign student restrictions linked to measurable drop in international biomedical graduate enrollment** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/25/foreign-students-us-biomedical-science-enrollment-drop-trump/?utm_campaign=rss)  
- New data confirm chilling effect on a key talent pipeline for US R&D despite court stalls.

---

# Public Health & Policy

**RFK Jr. weighs in on Army plan to detonate degraded toxic material in Iowa** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/25/health-news-rfk-jr-weighs-in-on-plan-to-detonate-toxic-material-in-iowa/?utm_campaign=rss)  
- Experts warn of dangerous health consequences; HHS secretary’s stance not detailed in brief.

**RFK Jr. partially redacted HHS calendar released** [STAT+](https://www.statnews.com/2026/11/24/rfk-jr-calendar-hhs-records-rollout/?utm_campaign=rss)  
- Public records show activities but with significant redactions limiting transparency.

**Advance care planning for children with life-limiting conditions — review** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43081808/)  
- Synthesis of approaches, barriers, and ethical frameworks for pediatric ACP.

**STI testing frequency in England (GUMCAD 2024): 80% test once annually; frequent testing concentrated in GBMSM (6.7%) and London (3.6%)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.04.08.26349546)  
- 2.2M testing episodes among 1.75M people; 66% episodes included chlamydia, gonorrhea, syphilis, HIV simultaneously.

**Equity gaps in genetic cardiomyopathy diagnosis: White participants more likely to have P/LP variants (13.9% vs 12.0%, p<0.001); White women higher syndromic diagnosis odds (OR 6.5, 95% CI 1.35–31.34)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368743)  
- All of Us analysis (414,830 genomes); income/education nominally associated with diagnostic coding.

**Rift Valley fever in Rwanda: livestock cases double every 9.3 days (R₀=1.78); modeling defines latest vaccination dates and priority sectors** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.22.26368714)  
- Simulation of 100,000 campaigns incorporating immunity delays; 48.5% coverage (90% efficacy) needed to halt spread.

**Protein sources in UK plant-based diets (FEED study, n=6,113): grains 10–30% across groups; dairy 12–14% in non-vegans; soy milk 4.3% in vegans; meat 33% in omnivores** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368579)  
- Plant-based meat alternatives major contributor for vegetarians/vegans; protein adequacy high across diets.

**French community pharmacies: 278k responses to 730k Google reviews across ~20k pharmacies (Sept–Oct 2026)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.21.26368650)  
- Response rate ~38%; sentiment and tone analyzed; AI-generated reviews and rating manipulation explored.

**Kinyarwanda→English clinical translation: GPT-4o-mini, GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Flash lead on 600 professional conversations** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368798)  
- Automated metrics (semantic similarity, BLEU, chrF, TER) and expert ratings (ICC) converge on top models.

**West Cameroon neonatal emergency care readiness: mean preparedness 51%; only 11% facilities high; bag-valve-mask 13%, functional incubator 19.5%** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368724)  
- Cross-sectional survey (185 facilities, 243 staff); critical equipment and protocol gaps identified.

**Dengue force-of-infection modeling in Java/Bali (2016–2024): Bayesian hierarchical model integrates case data + seroprevalence; many districts exceed WHO vaccine threshold but classified low-priority by reported incidence** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.07.15.26358208)  
- Covariates alone recover FOI point estimates but with poor uncertainty calibration; single serosurvey anchors credible intervals.

**ESC 2026 CVD–CKD guidelines: key learning points for nephrologists** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43081679/)  
- Joint ESC/ERA recommendations for cardiovascular risk management in chronic kidney disease.

**13–15 year follow-up design for women’s group intervention in rural Bangladesh (JiVitA-3 legacy)** [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/43080230/)  
- Protocol to assess long-term mortality and child health effects of a community participatory program.

**Pregnancy as diagnostic catch-up window: 2.4 additional hypertension diagnoses/1,000 women <20 weeks gestation (US claims, 175k deliveries)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368725)  
- Outpatient evaluation days rise after pregnancy onset; smaller effect for diabetes, larger for sickle cell trait.

**Nature-based retreat (5 days, n=18) increased resilience (CD-RISC-10 +5.08, p=0.0001) and well-being (WHO-5 +21.7)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.21.26368644)  
- Prospective observational; improvements sustained at 21 days across stress, affect, self-efficacy.

**Mucinous pancreatic cysts: 20-year single-center experience; surveillance vs. non-surveillance cancer outcomes; weighted risk score proposed** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368751)  
- Retrospective cohort (2006–2025); cyst-derived cancers categorized by detection pathway; survival by grade/stage.

**Oculopalatal tremor phenotypes: lesion location predicts HOD laterality; etiology predicts phenotype (hemorrhagic→combined OPT, ischemic→ocular-only, neoplastic→heterogeneous)** [medRxiv](https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.11.23.26368778)  
- Pooled patient-level analysis (501 HOD, 424 classifiable); bilateral HOD associated with ocular oscillations (OR 2.66).

---

**Worth watching**  
- **RIPTAC phase III launch** — first-in-class targeted protein degradation modality entering registrational testing; mechanism/indication still under wraps.  
- **CBP/EP300 inhibitor pocenbrodib** — single-patient clinical benefit in APM-resistant prostate cancer; network-nominated target warrants early-phase expansion.  
- **CONCERN-EWS mortality signal** — 36% reduction is striking but methodological concerns (spillover, exclusion bias, cluster imbalance) demand scrutiny before adoption.  
- **BioNTech founders’ $1B oncology spinout** — capital scale suggests platform ambition beyond single asset; watch for series A close and scientific advisory board.

youtube.markdown:
- Biology & Health
    - [Digital Health Vitals, Ep. 13: CMS AI Reimbursement, Oura's $625M Deal, Gemini & AI Scribe Layoffs](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=oSsFBXAE6p0) -- Digital Health Inside Out
        - Analyzes major digital health policy and market events, including CMS's Clinical Superintelligence Roadmap and potential government reimbursement models for healthcare AI.
        - Examines market consolidation and workforce reductions among AI scribe startups (such as Heidi Health) as basic AI capabilities become commoditized.
        - Highlights major digital health M&A activity, including Oura's $625 million acquisition of Counsel Health to support its broader business model and IPO strategy.
        - Debates the overall impact of healthtech on healthcare costs, featuring an expert prediction that GLP-1 medications may ultimately prove more transformative to healthcare than AI.
- Pure Science
    - [Scientists Said This Wave Was Impossible](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WbM7GP7QoEM) -- Veritasium
        - Investigates the physics of monster rogue waves, centered on the landmark Draupner rogue wave detection and space-borne observations from the MaxWave satellite survey.
        - Contrasts wind-driven wave dynamics and wave superposition against tsunami generation mechanisms and solitonic "waves of translation."
        - Details wave-tank experiments that demonstrate non-linear energy transfer within wave groups to synthesize rogue waves in controlled laboratory environments.
        - Explains how constructive interference from two crossing storm systems created the Draupner wave, and extends the fluid dynamics principles to rogue holes and optical rogue waves.
    - [The Riemann Hypothesis, Explained](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/EuE0WOdCliQ) -- Quanta Magazine
        - Introduces the Riemann Hypothesis, first proposed by Bernhard Riemann in 1859 and considered one of the most important unsolved problems in mathematics.
        - Connects the central mathematical conjecture to uncovering the order and distribution within prime numbers.
        - Previews a full-length video explainer on the historical context and mathematical significance of the hypothesis.
- To watch
    - [Why everyone gets time dilation wrong!](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/3OBIWZ3wK6Q) -- FloatHeadPhysics
